description: Agent Food Safety Records: submit supplier approval and receiving records with the certificates and reviews they answer to: the moment the records are read at; each supplier approval record with its id, reference, name, status (approved, conditional, suspended or removed), the moment approved and the days its record allows between reviews; each supplier certificate or guarantee with its id, reference, supplier, kind and the moment it expires; each receiving log entry with its id, reference, supplier, the lot code received, the product, the moment received and the certificate or guarantee it relies on; each supplier review with its id, reference, supplier and the moment reviewed. The signed report gives the receiving log and the suppliers, each supplier in the receiving log against an approval record in force, each certificate or guarantee a receipt relies on against its stated expiry, each received lot against the supplier and lot code behind it, and each approved supplier’s latest review against its approval record’s schedule, and counts them, and names divergent supplier records: a supplier appearing in the receiving log with no approval record on file, a supplier certificate or guarantee past its stated expiry that receiving still relies on, a received lot with no supplier or lot record behind it, and a supplier review recorded overdue against the approval record’s own schedule; then a receiving entry relying on a certificate the records do not hold and a review naming a supplier the approval records do not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No receiving log entries, or a review schedule with no reading moment, leaves those points unverified. Suppliers match by reference or by name without case, punctuation or company endings, certificates, entries and reviews match by letters and digits, a supplier reads as approved when its record is approved or conditional, a certificate expires after the day it states, and a review falls due once more days have passed since the latest review, or the approval when none is recorded, than the record allows. This reads whether every food lot received came from an approved supplier on current paperwork, with its supplier and lot on record. Verdict food_supplier_divergent, food_supplier_partial, food_supplier_unverified or food_supplier_consistent. POST /api/food-supplier-check. Reads the food safety records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it inspects no facility, takes no temperature, contacts no regulator or auditor and issues no certification, which stay with the business, its food safety team, its regulators and its auditors, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Food Safety Records reads a food business’s own safety records: food safety and HACCP plan records, critical-control-point and temperature monitoring logs, health inspection and third-party audit reports, recall and traceability records, supplier approval and receiving records, sanitation records, allergen and labeling records and corrective action records, each against the monitoring, inspection and corrective-action records, the corrective actions and the schedule, the plan’s limits and equipment, the lot traceability and inventory records, the supplier approvals and certificates, the cleaning schedule and safety data sheets, the formulation and production records or the deviations and verifications on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the food: what the plan requires, what the logs show, what the inspectors found, and whether the fixes and the traceability hold up; the Agent Customs Records family reads the border filings for goods as trade records, and the Agent Automotive family reads vehicle records, while this family reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-food-safety-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-food-safety-records/.
